title: arrhenatherum avenaceum var. nodosum
intro: Arrhenatherum avenaceum var. nodosum, commonly known as wood meadow-grass, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the grass family (Poaceae). The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of wood meadow-grass are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to have antioxidant and antimicrobial activities. Additionally, the plant has been used to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties, which help to relieve congestion and promote mucus discharge.
